title: Playtest orchestrator workflow: finding triage -> issue/update/direct PR
body:
Part of: #165
Depends on: #239, #240
Builds on: #216, `.github/workflows/codex-headless-pr.yml`, `.github/workflows/qa-publish.yml`

## Summary
Once findings are normalized, we need a trusted orchestrator that turns them into tracked work.

That orchestrator should run in GitHub Actions, apply the repo's execution gates, and choose the next action for each finding: skip, update an existing issue, create a new issue, dispatch a direct coding PR, or route to a human.

## Red
- The bridge from playtest findings to GitHub work is still largely manual.
- There is no scheduled/manual workflow that applies the repo's `safe-unattended` gates consistently.
- Direct PR dispatch is not yet tied to per-finding route decisions.
- Route reasons and confidence are not published as a durable dispatch ledger.

## Green
A scheduled/manual GitHub workflow can fetch unrouted findings, classify them with the repo's gates, and reliably choose `skip | update_issue | new_issue | direct_pr | human_review` without duplicating work.

## Scope
- Add a new GitHub Actions workflow for playtest orchestration:
  - `schedule`
  - `workflow_dispatch`
- Fetch unrouted findings from the Worker
- Load relevant open issues for duplicate/update matching
- Apply route rules and confidence thresholds
- Record route reason, confidence, and chosen action back to the finding ledger
- For `update_issue`:
  - post evidence/comment to the existing issue
- For `new_issue`:
  - create a new issue with session/finding context and suggested acceptance checks
- For `direct_pr`:
  - dispatch the existing PR engine (`codex-headless-pr.yml` or successor) only for findings that pass the unattended gates
- For `human_review`:
  - stop automation and route to a human-visible surface with exact blocker/reason
- Support dry-run and idempotent retry behavior

## Route Rules
Minimum guardrails for `direct_pr`:
- single-lane / non-conflicting scope
- portable context
- reviewer proof obtainable remotely
- no protected-path edits
- no product/design ambiguity
- finding confidence above threshold

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The workflow can run on schedule and via manual dispatch
- [ ] The same finding is not turned into duplicate issues or duplicate PR dispatches on rerun
- [ ] Safe unattended findings can dispatch a coding PR through the existing PR workflow
- [ ] Ambiguous/design-sensitive findings are routed to a human surface instead of auto-coded
- [ ] The route reason and confidence are written to a durable ledger and GitHub-visible summary
- [ ] The unattended path uses API keys/secrets, not personal subscriptions

## Suggested Lane
`qa-platform` with `infra-deploy` review

## Suggested Execution Mode
`validate-and-propose-only` until #239 lands; then `safe-unattended` for eligible findings
